name: option-test-1b0c555df9/missing_option_value-p.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: "Supports [`required-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#required-params), [`defaultable-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#defaultable-params), [`included-record-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#included-record-param) and [`rest-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#rest-param) in the signature"
reason: The included-record parameter signature is supported, but the asserted behavior is command-line option parsing: invoking main with --val and no value must panic. Subset 10 does not specify command-line binding or missing-option-value rejection, so this essential behavior is not covered.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line binding of --val to an included record parameter and panic for a missing option value.
test_design_notes: The @args ["--val"] and @panic directives assert launcher behavior; the empty main body contains no explicit panic.
